query: Legionnaires disease New York City August 2025 cases deaths outbreak DOHMH
query_rationale: Targets NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH) official communications — health alerts, epi data briefs, press releases, and outbreak investigation reports — for Legionnaires' disease in August 2025. DOHMH is the primary authoritative source for NYC Legionnaires' disease surveillance. Natural-language query without over-quoted phrases improves recall against real document text. 'August 2025' matches how documents are dated.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: NYC DOHMH health alert, epi data brief, press release, or outbreak investigation report with case counts and dates
expected_trust_signal: Official NYC government domain (nyc.gov), DOHMH authorship, notifiable disease report language

query: Legionnaires disease NYC outbreak August 2025 cooling tower cases hospitalizations
query_rationale: News sources frequently report NYC Legionnaires' disease outbreaks with case counts, deaths, and borough-level locality details, often citing DOHMH directly. Cooling tower is included because NYC Local Law 77 makes cooling-tower-linked clusters the dominant outbreak type reported in news. August is peak Legionnaires' season (summer), increasing likelihood of news coverage. This query targets news articles from August 2025 that would contain evidence quotes and numerical case data.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: News article from major outlet (NYT, NY Post, NY Daily News, Gothamist, AP) reporting case counts, deaths, or outbreak cluster with DOHMH attribution
expected_trust_signal: Named journalist, DOHMH spokesperson quote, specific case/death numbers, borough or neighborhood location

query_rationale: ProMED (Program for Monitoring Emerging Diseases) and CDC MMWR are authoritative secondary validation sources that aggregate and republish outbreak reports, including NYC Legionnaires' disease clusters. ProMED posts are frequently the first internationally visible record of US outbreak investigations. MMWR may publish rapid reports or notes on significant NYC clusters. This query targets these channels specifically for August 2025 NYC events, providing cross-validation of case counts from official NYC sources.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: ProMED post, CDC MMWR report, or WHO event report referencing NYC Legionnaires' disease cases or outbreak in August 2025
expected_trust_signal: ProMED archive post with moderator commentary, MMWR citation with DOI, CDC.gov domain, WHO event page
